column1: # Deployment proxy policy: section|proxy|reason
# The deployment runs its own network steps in two classes. A section marked
# "yes" reaches the internet through the deployment proxy; a section marked
# "no" runs without one. The rules are here so the choice is reviewed rather
# than implied by the order of the steps.
# Loopback never goes through the proxy, so the local agent daemons stay
# reachable in every section.
install-managers|yes|manager releases are fetched from GitHub
apply-source.skills|yes|skill clones and archive downloads
install-agents|yes|agent packages are fetched from the npm registry
install-proxy|yes|the proxy release itself is fetched from GitHub
apply-source|no|the source application only reads and writes local files
apply-source.agent-payload|no|the payload copy is local
apply-source.client-settings|no|the settings merge is local
apply-source.caveman-proxy|no|the gateway is reached over loopback
apply-source.macos-discovery|no|the configuration check is local
install-common|no|the regional conda mirror is the fast path
install-installer-tools|yes|Homebrew packages are fetched from the Homebrew CDN
prepare-shell|no|the startup resources are generated locally
configure-system|no|the system configuration is local
set-login-shell|no|the account configuration is local
